user_intent: Verify live that the AG Brain autonomously executes job discovery, filters roles with high precision (disqualifying non-matching tech stacks like Angular and AI engineering, approving pinpoint Java backend roles), commits applications via 1-click and chatbot drawers, bookmarks external jobs via the native Save button, and self-learns screening Q&A into candidate memory.
why_user_made_such_thinking: The user needed tangible empirical proof that the autonomous system operates flawlessly in live production without comma corruption, without tab leaks, without applying to unqualified roles, and with proper handling of external company website applications.
why_user_performed_this_way: The user demanded strict accountability: that the AG Brain proves itself capable of handling live browser automation, complex questionnaires (fixed compensation, resume confirmation, relocation), and external redirect handling autonomously.
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: High satisfaction with empirically verified outcomes: 3 successful applications committed (Transunion Lead Java Developer via Chatbot, Hackajob Lead Software Engineer Java via 1-Click, Kelly Backend Developer via 1-Click), 2 external roles cleanly bookmarked with native Save button (LTM and JPMorgan Chase), and 0-score disqualification of non-matching roles (Angular Fullstack and Specialized AI Engineer).
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes. The AI actively resolved live IPC requests in real time: answered screening questions with factual candidate truth, synthesized tailored resumes, evaluated job fit according to pinpoint qualification criteria, and maintained single-tab hygiene in Chrome CDP.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes. Applications committed to applications_tracker.csv, external jobs saved to saved_external_jobs.json and bookmarked on portal, screening answers recorded into cognitive_learnings.json, and continuous discovery cycle progressing cleanly without comma or slug errors.
evolutionary_takeaways: 1. Combining real-time AG Brain cognitive evaluation with fast ATS resume tailoring and automated chatbot resolution yields a resilient, zero-hallucination application engine. 2. Native Save button interaction ensures candidate visibility into external jobs without getting trapped in third-party ATS redirects. 3. Continuous recording of answered screening questions into cognitive_learnings.json builds compound institutional intelligence.
